content.verse_text: Immediately the father of the child cried out and said, 'I believe; help my unbelief!'
content.reflection: This father didn't pretend his faith was perfect. He brought his doubt straight to Jesus — and Jesus met him there. Honest doubt isn't the opposite of faith; it's the doorway to deeper trust. You don't have to have it all figured out to come to God.

content.caption:
Read this if you're doubting today

This father's prayer in Mark 9:24 might be the most honest verse in the Bible: "I believe; help my unbelief!"

He didn't hide his doubt. He didn't wait until his faith was "strong enough." He brought it straight to Jesus — and Jesus met him right there.

If you're in a season where belief feels hard, you're in good company. Honest doubt isn't the opposite of faith. It's often the doorway to deeper trust.
